thread:
laura_cs: Onboarding flag - customer (AtlasMaps) sees intermittent 403s during validation runs. Server in their CI always succeeds but their local tests fail sometimes.

laura_cs: They pasted curl run (token redacted):
```bash
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" -d '{"model":"rwd-2-small","input":"ping"}'
```

laura_cs: Failing response when it happens:
```json
HTTP/2 403
{"error":"invalid_auth","message":"token not valid for this region"}
```

felix_engineer: "token not valid for this region" is our edge message when the API key is scoped to a specific region and the request reached a different regional edge. Ask for request-ids and the host they hit (they said sometimes they hit eu.api.redwood.ai and sometimes api.redwood.ai).

laura_cs: request-ids: req_reg1 and req_reg2. They said CI hits us-east consistently, desktop dev machine hits eu.* sometimes (VPN + corporate DNS).

maya_infra: confirms: we issue keys scoped to a region for some enterprise plans. Keys carry a region claim; if a request routes to another region we reject with 403. Intermittent DNS/VPN routing can cause the flip.

felix_engineer: quick repro: run curl against eu endpoint vs global endpoint with same key. Example:
```bash
curl -v https://eu.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" -d '{"model":"rwd-2-small","input":"hi"}'
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXX" -d '{"model":"rwd-2-small","input":"hi"}'
```

laura_cs: they ran both: eu -> 200, global -> 403 when global resolved to us-west because key is EU-only.

felix_engineer: two remediation paths for onboarding: 1) Pin SDK/clients to the appropriate regional host (eu.api.redwood.ai) so DNS/VPN won't cause cross-region hits. 2) Ask CS to request a global-scoped key from sales if they need cross-region testing (requires entitlement). For quick unblock, tell them to set REDWOOD_API_HOST to eu.* in their .env.

maya_infra: also note that heavy fanout during retries can cause our rate limits to trigger in the allowed region if clients bounce between regions and retry; they might see a burst of 429s following 403 retries. Recommend small retry window and prefer region pinning.

laura_cs: customer pinned to eu host and re-ran smoke tests; green. They asked for a KB note about region-scoped keys and DNS pitfalls.

felix_engineer: follow-up SDK item: add clearer error text in client SDKs when we detect region-mismatch (include expected region claim and suggest host override). Filing ticket.

ratebot: note: observed 3x retry-induced 429 incidents in last 24h for that account while they retried global host.

laura_cs: I'll mark renewal-risk as low (brief pause <48h). Scheduling a short enablement call to walk through env var and host pin. Adding KB steps and the curl repro to the support ticket.

maya_infra: docs note: if customers use VPNs or corporate DNS that may resolve global host to local egress, recommend explicit regional endpoints for stability.

laura_cs: thanks all 44d closing loop with AtlasMaps now.
